name: Vehicle_Maintenance_Log
label: Vehicle Maintenance Log
_about: Truck Maintenance (spec v1.4, Delivery 08 §2, TK-R4): type, date, km, shop, cost, receipts. Cost is 'restricted to admin, supervisor' by the spec; this app has no field-level role masking anywhere yet (same gap noted for Third_Party_Fee), so it is stored but not hidden from anyone who can read this form.
